usage: Original generated atlases preserved. Runtime UV meshes isolate each alpha silhouette; materials from existing paper kits are reused in Kanto assemblies.

prompts.prompt: Twelve isolated Kanto signature cutouts: eight gym landmarks, Rocket console, Silph capsule, Lavender memorial, Cinnabar bookcase. Thin layered cardstock, transparent atlas, 1536 × 1024.

Production game texture atlas of 12 individual Kanto and Sevii architectural PAPER CUTOUTS for an intricate pop-up Pokémon terrarium. Transparent background, 1536x1024, strict regular 4 columns 3 rows grid, one isolated cutout per cell, broad clear transparent padding. Front view, flat thin card construction, warm cream cut edges, intricate many layered paper appliqués, delicately printed windows, foliage cutout details, rich polished illustrated craft, NOT low-poly 3D models, no finished scene or background plate. Row1: 1 small Pallet Town white cottage with red roof chimney flower pots; 2 Viridian green-roof shop facade with striped awning and leafy vines; 3 Pewter museum facade with fossil relief in pediment and columns; 4 Cerulean white blue-roof cottage with blue awning, flower pots and a bicycle leaning outside. Row2: 5 Vermilion harbor lighthouse with tiny striped flag and rope; 6 Lavender narrow pagoda bell tower with lilac roof, memorial flowers and hanging small bell; 7 Celadon elegant department store facade with red and cream awnings and balcony plants; 8 Saffron tall glass Silph office tower with stepped silhouette. Row3: 9 Fuchsia traditional wood safari lodge with straw eaves, fern planters and small animal footprints on sign (NO WRITING); 10 Cinnabar white laboratory facade red roof with antenna and tiny specimen bottles visible at window; 11 Sevii weathered seaside blue timber house with shell garland, stacked fishing nets and lavender flowers; 12 Sevii market stall with green fabric canopy, baskets of berries, folded map and lantern. No names or labels, no text, no characters, no ground slab, no cast shadows outside silhouettes. Objects must be crisp and completely separated, not overlap neighboring grid cells. Detailed but clearly PAPER.
